result.title: Continuum Attention
result.summary: We introduce Continuum Attention (CA), a causal Transformer attention operator that replaces discrete key and value lookup with integration over a continuous, piecewise linear memory curve. Each query induces an exponential relevance density along the curve. Integrating the density and interpolated values yields exact normalized attention from closed form exponential moments, including half token boundary contributions. The gradients follow analytically from moments of order at most two, enabling parallel GPU implementations while retaining quadratic sequence complexity and the standard Transformer decoder. Compared with ordinary softmax and focal attention, CA reduces mean validation negative log likelihood by 0.0200 and 0.0480 nats per byte, respectively, winning all paired comparisons. An additional disjoint validation slice yields a 0.0457 nats per byte advantage over the strongest selected softmax baseline, with a paired 95% confidence interval. These findings motivate continuous integration as a promising attention alternative while leaving larger scale generalization open.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Continuum Attention：以对连续分段线性记忆曲线的积分替代离散 key/value 查表，每个 query 产生指数相关性密度，借助闭式指数矩（含半 token 边界贡献）得到精确归一化注意力，梯度可由至多二阶矩解析给出，在语言建模验证损失上小幅优于 softmax 与 focal attention。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本注意力算子，未涉及视觉或推理期 latent 状态；但其把记忆视为连续曲线并用相关性密度积分做加权的思路，可能为 LVR 中跨位置视觉证据聚合与潜在状态的连续性/软边界表示提供注意力结构层面的核查线索。
